parameters.help_en:
The OSS URL of the media file to censor. Video and audio files are supported. You can obtain the URL from the MPS console under Media Management > Media List. To censor an image file, use the `CoverImage` parameter. Specify this parameter as a JSON object. For details, see the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html.

Bucket: The name of the input file's OSS bucket.

Location: The OSS region. This must match the region of your MPS service.

Object: The OSS object to scan.

The object name cannot start with a forward slash (/). Otherwise, the API call fails

Bucket：输入文件OSS Bucket名称。
Location：OSS区域，必须和MPS服务所在区域一致。

The object name cannot start with a forward slash (/). Otherwise, the API call fails

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the pipeline that is used for message notifications. You can obtain the ID from the MPS console under Global Settings > Pipelines. If you do not specify this parameter, the default pipeline is used. The default pipeline has a concurrency of 10. To increase the concurrency, submit a <props="china">ticket (https://selfservice.console.aliyun.com/ticket/category/mts/recommend/1186)</props><props="intl">ticket (https://workorder-intl.console.aliyun.com/?spm=5176.12246746.top-nav.ditem-sub.35da7bbcitpQnr#/ticket/createIndex)</props>.

Currently, pipelines can only be created on the backend. To query and update pipelines, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188374.html

parameters.help_en:
The video censorship configuration and the OSS URL for output snapshots. You can obtain the URL from the MPS console under Media Management > Media List.

This parameter is a JSON object.

OutputFile:

Bucket: The name of the output OSS bucket.

Location: The OSS region. This must be the same as the region where the MPS service resides.

Object: The OSS object for the output. The {Count} placeholder is replaced with the sequence number of the snapshot.

  The detailed censorship results are saved in a file named {jobId}.output in the same directory as the OutputFile. For information about the fields in the output file, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/609186.html.

StoreVideoTimeline: Specifies whether to generate a `{jobId}.video_timeline` file and store it in OSS. Set the value to `true` to generate the file. If you set the value to `false` or omit the parameter, the system does not generate the file. For details about the file format, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91779.html.

SaveType: The output mode. `abnormal` saves only snapshots of problematic content. `all` saves all snapshots.

Biztype: The censorship template. The default value is `common`. To use a custom censorship template, you must submit a ticket. After your custom template is configured, set this parameter to your user ID (UID).

Scene: The detection scenes. You can select one or more scenes. If you do not specify this parameter, the system defaults to the `porn` and `terrorism` scenes. Valid scenes:

`porn`: pornographic content

`terrorism`: terrorist content

`ad`: text-image policy violations

`live`: undesirable scenes

`logo`: logos

`audio`: audio anti-spam

For input files that have an audio track, the `audio` scene performs audio censorship. Do not specify the `audio` scene for input files that do not have an audio track
parameters.help_zh:
视频审核配置和输出截图的OSS地址。可以通过MPS控制台 > 媒体管理 > 媒体列表获取。

JSON对象。

OutputFile：
    - Bucket：输出文件OSS Bucket名字。
    - Location：OSS区域，必须和MPS服务所在区域一致。
    - Object: 待检测OSS Object，其中{Count}为截帧图片序号替换符。

   其中，审核结果详细信息保存在OutputFile相同的文件夹下，命名为{jobId}.output，output文件具体字段格式，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/609186.html。
StoreVideoTimeline: 审核是否要输出`{jobId}.video_timeline`文件，存储在OSS中。true：表示要输出，false表示不输出，不填默认不输出。文件格式，请参见，https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91779.html。
SaveType：输出模式。abnormal表示只输出有问题的截帧，all表示输出所有截帧。
Biztype：表示审核模版。common为默认模版，不填默认为common，如果需要自定义审核模版需要提工单，然后将用户的uid填入此项。
Scene：检测场景。Scenes可以选择检测场景，不填默认检测暴恐和涉黄。可选场景：

    - porn：涉黄
    - terrorism：暴恐
    - ad：图文违规
    - live：不良场景
    - logo：图标

    - audio：语音反垃圾

对于有音频轨道的输入文件，audio场景会进行音频审核，没有音轨的输入文件不要填写audio
